law: no step may be skipped; AI may diagnose/propose/write candidate code and tests/critique but may NEVER self-approve, NEVER touch Lane A, and NEVER promote itself; governance-touching proposals REQUIRE human approval; every stage carries evidence

proposal_fields.proposed_by: agent_id | provider envelope ref | human (AI proposals tagged is_ai=true)
proposal_fields.requires_human: bool — validator FORCES true when governance_touching=true
proposal_fields.candidate_diff_ref: sandbox branch/patch ref, never applied to Lane A
proposal_fields.test_battery: list of test refs incl. new tests
proposal_fields.approvals: list of {approver, ts}; rule: proposer may NOT be an approver; AI identity may NEVER be an approver

hard_rules: governance_touching=true and no human approval record => stuck at AWAITING_HUMAN forever (by design)
